sloka: बभूव परम प्रीतो देवैः इव पितामहः ।ते यदा ज्ञान संपन्नाः सर्वैः समुदिता गुणैः ॥१-१८-३४॥
transliteration: babhūva parama prīto devaiḥ iva pitāmahaḥ ।te yadā jñāna saṁpannāḥ sarvaiḥ samuditā guṇaiḥ ॥1-18-34॥

translations.english: All his sons were enriched with knowledge and endowed with all virtues. They were modest, renowned, omniscient and farsighted. Dasaratha rejoiced at the sight of those glorious sons with such faculties and looked like Brahma, Lord of the worlds.
